sources.entry: tududi - Task management tool with hierarchical structure, smart recurring tasks, and seamless Telegram integration. (Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: tududi is a self-hosted personal task and project manager with hierarchical areas, projects, tasks and notes, recurring tasks, and CalDAV and OIDC/SSO support.
summary.what_it_does: Lets users create tasks, projects, areas (groups of projects), notes, and tags, with each task optionally linked to a project and tasks and notes taggable. Tasks support subtasks with progress tracking, filters for Today, Upcoming and Someday, and sorting by name, due date, creation date or priority. Recurring tasks cover daily, weekly, monthly, monthly on weekdays and monthly last-day patterns, with custom intervals, completion-based repeats and optional end dates. The README also describes project sharing, roles and groups for households or teams, an installable PWA with offline caching, and a REST API with Swagger docs and personal API keys. CalDAV sync is described for clients such as tasks.org, Apple Reminders, Thunderbird and Evolution, plus external servers like Nextcloud and Baikal. Data is stored in SQLite by default, with optional PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL.
use_cases: Personal to-do list and task tracking
Organizing projects into areas with subtasks
Managing recurring household or work chores
Syncing tasks with CalDAV clients on phone or desktop
Sharing projects and assigning tasks within a family or small team
Single sign-on login for a self-hosted task app
Automating task creation through a REST API
how_to_run: docker run -e TUDUDI_USER_EMAIL=admin@example.com -e TUDUDI_USER_PASSWORD=your-secure-password -e TUDUDI_SESSION_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 64) -v ~/tududi_db:/app/db -v ~/tududi_uploads:/app/uploads -v ~/tududi_backups:/app/backups -p 3002:3002 -d chrisvel/tududi:latest
Alternatively: cp .env.example .env, edit values, then docker-compose up -d
notable: Recurring tasks with parent-child linking so generated instances stay connected to their pattern
CalDAV bidirectional sync with RRULE support and encrypted stored passwords (AES-256-GCM)
OIDC/SSO with multiple providers, just-in-time provisioning and admin assignment by email domain
Families and teams mode with roles, groups, and members who have no email and sign in via a link
Upgrades back up the SQLite file automatically before running migrations
caveats: Reverse-proxy setups need TUDUDI_TRUST_PROXY set or express-rate-limit logs a validation error
Upgrading from v1.1.x requires changing the Docker volume path or new data is lost on container recreation
Setting DATABASE_URL or DB_DIALECT switches to PostgreSQL, and the container refuses to start over a populated SQLite database unless configured accordingly
